title: Counterfactual Reward Model Training for Bias Mitigation in Multimodal Reinforcement Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting framing bias by swapping sentiment terms and randomly changing influential words to evaluate the model's robustness, and measuring counterfactual shifts to decompose political framing bias from topical bias.
Perturbing the distribution of news subjects (e.g., politics) and author/source frequencies to simulate disproportionate coverage and measuring statistical divergence.

Generating counterfactuals by perturbing unspecified protected attributes in the data and measuring the average absolute change in reward predictions to calculate a counterfactual consistency penalty.
